segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַשּׁוֹפֵךְ מַיִם בִּרְשׁוּת הָרַבִּים, וְהוּזַּק בָּהֶן אַחֵר – חַיָּיב בְּנִזְקוֹ. הַמַּצְנִיעַ אֶת הַקּוֹץ וְאֶת הַזְּכוּכִית; וְהַגּוֹדֵר אֶת גְּדֵרוֹ בְּקוֹצִים; וְגָדֵר שֶׁנָּפַל לִרְשׁוּת הָרַבִּים; וְהוּזְּקוּ בָּהֶן אֲחֵרִים – חַיָּיב בְּנִזְקָן.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «one who pours water in the public domain, and another» person «incurred damage due to it,» the one who poured water «is liable» to pay «for his damage.» In the case of «one who conceals a thorn or a piece of glass» in his wall adjacent to the public domain, «or one who puts up a fence of thorns, or» one who puts up «a fence that» subsequently «fell into the public domain, and others incurred damage due to» any of «these, he is liable» to pay «for their damage.»

moves.summary: one who pours water in the public domain is liable for resulting damage
thorns/glass concealed, thorn fence, fallen fence: liable

positions.claim: one who pours water, conceals thorns or glass, or whose fence falls into the public domain is liable for damage
